findings.explanation: HOL4's only clause is RESULT (Result t) = t. This constructor-pattern definition goes through Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition, which uses new_specification (Defn.sml:1182-1197, Prim_rec.sml:281). So only that clause is saved, with no _primitive ARB equation, and RESULT (Clash t) is unconstrained. Lean sets RESULT (Clash t) := ARB. It therefore proves RESULT (Clash t) = ARB and, by proof irrelevance of the Nonempty witness, RESULT (Clash a) = RESULT (Clash b) for all a, b. It also proves RESULT (Clash a) = CLASH (Result a). HOL4 leaves all of these open; for example, an interpretation with RESULT (Clash t) = t satisfies RESULT_def.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntaxLib

example {α : Type} (a b : α) : Candle.RESULT (Candle.result.Clash a) = Candle.RESULT (Candle.result.Clash b) := rfl

example {α : Type} (a : α) : Candle.RESULT (Candle.result.Clash a) = @HOL.ARB α ⟨a⟩ := rfl
findings.hol4_check: ?f:'a result -> 'a. (!t. f (Result t) = t) /\ (!t. f (Clash t) = t)

findings.explanation: HOL4's only clause is CLASH (Clash t) = t. It is made by new_recursive_definition/new_specification, so only that clause is saved and CLASH (Result t) is unconstrained. Lean sets CLASH (Result t) := ARB. It therefore proves CLASH (Result t) = ARB and, by proof irrelevance of the Nonempty witness, CLASH (Result a) = CLASH (Result b) for all a, b. It also proves CLASH (Result a) = RESULT (Clash a). HOL4 leaves all of these open; for example, an interpretation with CLASH (Result t) = t satisfies CLASH_def.

example {α : Type} (a b : α) : Candle.CLASH (Candle.result.Result a) = Candle.CLASH (Candle.result.Result b) := rfl
